steps.tx: Jump towards the Cirrusfly Queen and use your racial.
From now on collect Windstone Clusters during the next couple of quests. GO OUT OF YOUR WAY to do so.
Take the SKINNING reward for the next quest and learn skinning.
Set your to Zephras Isle at Zephras Isle (43, 43.2)
Set your to Zephras Isle at Zephras Isle (62.2, 72.6)
### THIS IS OPTIONAL, IF YOU JUST CARE TO GET OUT OF THE STARTING ZONE, CHECK EVERY BOX TILL THE NEXT CAPSLOCK MESSAGE###
### THE OPTIONAL AREA IS DONE### (If you did not do the OPTIONAL part you will see some incomplete TurnIns,just ignore them)

steps.tx: Learn First Aid at Nurse Neela
Vendor at Mrs. Winters Tirisfal Glades (61.2, 52.6)
Get the flightpath at: Silverpine Forest (45.6, 42.6)
Loot the book in the shelf. Silverpine Forest (43.4, 41.3)
Loot the book in the shelf. Tirisfal Glades (59.4, 52.3)
Run into Undercity and take the right elevator.

steps.tx: Look for a RFC dungeon-group. There are 5 quests that will net you roughly 1.5levels. This guide assumes that you have done the dungeon by the end of this guide-part. As Undead,Orc or Troll you either find a Tauren to share the 2 Thunderbluff quests for RFC or run to Thunderbluff yourself now. I will send you to TB after RFC either way so I recommend to find somone to share the quests.
Turn the quests in before level 19 at your convenience.
I expect you to have done RFC by now.
Start looking for a group for Ruins of Lordaeron

steps.ad: Pre-quest for A Recipe For Death
Pre-quest for A Recipe For Death

steps.tx: Do Ruins of Lordaeron. There are 4 quests outside and 2 inside. One drops from "The Baron" and The Crest can spawn in 4 different areas.
Next to the last quest-turnin is the NPC where you can turnin your books you have been collecting so far.
Get the flightpath at: Stonetalon Mountains (45.1, 59.9)
Start looking for a WC group.

Unfortunately the quest Deviate Hides will not be doable in just one run. I usually dont accept it to give other players more chance of completing theirs. I add it to this guide for "good measures" only, I never expect you to actually do/finish it.
After Verdan the Everliving has died all Serpentblooms in the instance respawn.
Talk to Sputtervalveand ask him about the glowing shard.
During the next quest you will get a questItem named Note Scrap. Accept it as soon as possible. During Beren's Peril go as deep into the cave as possible.
Once you use the provided QuestItem an Elite ghost will spawn. Its not "properly Elite" though but make sure youre full health and use big cooldowns if need be.
Get the flightpath at: Hillsbrad Foothills (60.2, 18.6)
Kill the dog after he transforms,he gives above average XP! Looks like on Forever they removed this :( RIP Stanley Experience.
Start looking for a Shadowfang Keep group.
Get the flightpath in: Ashenvale (coords soonTM)

steps.ad: The guide forgot to pick this up

steps.tx: Kill the druid Ursangous here. Ashenvale (39.2, 65.1) He is in bear form and patrols a little(see Questie-Worldmap for this) CAREFUL there is a GIANT Elite nightelf Tree patrolling around here too.
At the next quest there is a named Waterelemental called Tideress. Usually pretty close to the little island. He drops a questitem. Accept it.

Kill the panther Shadumbra here. Ashenvale (55.6, 53.4) He patrols a little left and right. Like 20seconds in each direction from where Questie shows the quest. CAREFUL at Raynewood Retreat there are HIGH LEVEL NIGHTELF ELITE GUARDS.
Get the Etched Vial from the laughing Sisters around Raynewood Retreat. AGAIN: CAREFUL at Raynewood Retreat there are HIGH LEVEL NIGHTELF ELITE GUARDS.
Careful you will get ambushed by 4 Nightelves in the building. This can be soloed as they dont have "normal hp" in comparison. But use all cooldowns you have+Potions if need be.
Start looking for a group for Blackfathom Deeps.

There is a dropquest(Damp Note, Allegience to the Old Gods) with a REALLY low dropchance. If you get it you could turn it in and get the follow or just continue and "ignore" the follow quest. Usually I skip it entirely.
The Essences can only be found BEFORE the dungeon. There are not enough for 5 people but the respawn is quite fast. Another quest you could "skip".
The Fathom Core is found in the room with all the Twilight's Hammer NPCs. Its in the water. On looting it it will spawn Baron Aquanis(A boss) who also drops a quest.

steps.ad: The guide forgot to pick this up

steps.tx: Get the flightpath at: Thousand Needles (45, 49.2)
For the next quest: There are lvl 30+ lions around. Just run through them, dont attack them. They will reset before you get to the questpoint. Use a potion/defensive cooldown if you really need to.
Loot the scroll at Thousand Needles (34.5, 40.1).

Do the Elite quest around Humberts sword if you can, otherwise do the wetlands dungeon now. Even if you do not, go through the non-dungeon steps in it. I will add the "Accept" part of the Elite quests the do/Turnin you can figure out yourself when to do that.
Get the flightpath at: Arathi Highlands (73.0, 32.6)
Get the flightpath at: Arathi Highlands (73.0, 32.6)

From now on the guide will follow the NON-Updated classic 31-60route and might still have flaws, the beta only gave us access to 1-30. 30-60 will be updated regularly in January(Before I am busy as ill be leading a top #30 world guild). Please post any issues on my discord so I can fix them as soon as possible.
KEEP!!!!! 10 Turtle Meat for a future quest.
Start looking for a Gnomeregan group
Get the flightpath at: Stranglethorn Vale (26.8, 77.0)
If its available on the auction house, buy: 1 Silver Bar 1 Moss Agate
Set your Hearthstone to Orgrimmar at Orgrimmar (54.1, 68.4)
Get the flightpath at: Stranglethorn Vale (32.6, 29.2)
Buy: 1 Soothing Spices at Christoph Jeffcoat
If you can get a group together for the elite quests in Dun Garok. This is your last chance to do them, if not skip until the next "Run" part.
Start looking for a Dalaran City dungeon group. You can do the Arathi quests before or after.

steps.ad: The guide forgot to pick this up

steps.tx: Leaving the group will teleport you to Tarren Mill. Do so. If you are the last one in the dungeon: Get invited to a group by a friend/guildie and then drop the group.
Buy: 1 Cherry Grog at Nixxrax Fillamug
Buy all missing STV Pages if you can on the auction house. These are:
Put them on your bank for now, if you cant buy em all now,write down wich ones are missing! Youll get two more chances to buy them
Alternatively you could do some Scarlet Monestary runs or Razorfen Downs.
Grind in in the elementals area till level
Get the flightpath at: Swamp of Sorrows (46.0, 54.6)
Look for Noboru the Cudgel (Make a macro /Target Noboru). He wanders around in the area you just ran to. He drops a weapon wich also is a questItem. Accept it.
Grind in at the rock elemental areas till level

Buy your missing Stranglethorn Pages as well as *Frost Oil*,*Gyrochronatom* and *Patterned Bronze Bracers* from the AH. For the Items: IN THIS ORDER AS WELL, If you cant get Item 1->Dont buy item 2 and 3, they rely on each other as pre quests.

LAST CHANCE to buy your missing Stranglethorn Pages.
Get all pages out now, if youre still missing some try to trade via /1.
Grind in in the troll area till level

Set your Hearthstone to Feralas at Feralas (74.8, 45.0)
Grind in in this area till level

Grind in the Gnoll or Tauren area till level

You should have a questItem. "Perfect Yeti Hide". Accept it (If you dont have it,kill more yetis!)
Grind in in the yeti area till level

steps.tx: For these quests you need the following:
You should have a questItem called "Imperfect Draenethyst Fragment ".(If you dont,dont farm for it) Accept it.
Grind in anywhere in Blasted Lands till level
Buy 15x Silk Cloth from the auction house.
Get the flightpath at: Searing Gorge (34.8, 30.8)
Grind in in the dimetrodon area till level
Collect 7 crystals of each color (Red,Green,Blue,Yellow) during the next quests.
You gotta have all crystals by now. Also you should have gotten a questItem called " Mangled Journal". Accept it.
Get the flightpath at: Un'Goro Crater (45.2, 5.8)

steps.ad: The guide forgot to pick this up

steps.tx: Use your Evergreen Puch every 10minutes now till you got 10 Morrowgrain
Grind in in the naga area till level
Grind in in this area till level
You should have gotten a questItem called "Empty Firewater Flask". Accept it.
Buy "Mithril casing" from the auction house.
Next quest is an escort. If youre in a group make sure that everyone only turns in yet and then accept afterwards.
Grind in anywhere in Un'Goro till level
Use the Videre Elixir(This will kill you,dont ress up!)
Careful with this area, this is pretty hard solo(even for good players) as you accidently pull regularly here. Either get a group for this or be aware of patrols 24/7!
Next quest is an escort. If youre in a group make sure that everyone only turns in yet and then accept afterwards.Careful she dies easily before she got her equipment back.
If you found a questItem called "Blue-feathered Necklace" yet, Accept it.(Dont farm for it though)
Set your Hearthstone to Undercity at Undercity (67.8, 38.6)
Go through the blackrock and enter Burning Steppes.
Get the flightpath at: Burning Steppes (65.6, 24.2)
Get the flightpath at: Eastern Plaguelands (80.2, 57.0)
Grind in in this area till level
